trialDuration.q: How long is the free trial?
trialDuration.a: The free trial lasts 45 days with all modules unlocked. For HR/Payroll and Production, the trial is extended to 60 days. You can extend up to 90 days by reaching activation milestones (data import, entries created, users invited).

noCard.q: Do I need a credit card to sign up?
noCard.a: No. The trial is completely free and requires no credit card. You only pay if you decide to subscribe after the trial.

migration.q: Can I migrate from Sage or another software?
migration.a: Yes. Our team supports your migration from Sage, QuickBooks, Ciel or any other tool for free. We transfer your chart of accounts, entries, customers and suppliers.

afterTrial.a: At the end of the trial, your account automatically switches to Onusuite Solo (free forever, limited). Your data is never lost. You can subscribe to a paid plan at any time.

cancel.q: Can I cancel at any time?
cancel.a: Yes. There is no mandatory commitment (unless you choose the annual plan with −20%). You can cancel at any time, your data remains accessible in read-only mode for 21 days.

support.a: During the trial: chat and email. On paid plans: chat, email, and phone support depending on your tier. Personalized onboarding is offered for SMEs.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By accessing or using Onusuite, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the service.

eligibility.title: 2. Eligibility
eligibility.body: You must be at least 18 years old and have the legal capacity to enter into a contract. You represent that the information provided during registration is accurate and complete.

accounts.title: 3. Accounts and Security
accounts.body: You are responsible for the security of your account and credentials. You must immediately notify Onusuite of any unauthorized use of your account. Onusuite will not be liable for losses related to compromised credentials.

trial.title: 4. Free Trial
trial.body: Onusuite offers a 45-day free trial with all modules unlocked, no credit card required. At the end of the trial, the account automatically switches to the free Onusuite Solo plan (limited). No data is lost.

subscriptions.title: 5. Subscriptions and Payments
subscriptions.body: Paid subscriptions are billed monthly or annually. Prices are listed in USD (1 USD = 1 EUR). Annual commitment receives a 20% discount. You can cancel at any time. Refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis.

acceptableUse.title: 6. Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.body: You agree not to use Onusuite for any illegal, fraudulent, or abusive purpose. You must not attempt to access other tenants' data, compromise platform security, or use the service to store illicit content.

data.title: 7. Data and Privacy
data.body: Your data is stored securely and encrypted. Onusuite acts as a data processor under GDPR and applicable local regulations. See our Privacy Policy for details.

ip.title: 8. Intellectual Property
ip.body: Onusuite, its logo, source code, and content are the exclusive property of Onusuite. You retain full ownership of your business data. No part of the platform may be copied or redistributed without authorization.

disclaimer.title: 9. Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: Onusuite is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind, express or implied. The platform does not constitute legal, tax, or accounting advice. You are responsible for the compliance of your tax and legal filings.

liability.title: 10. Limitation of Liability
liability.body: To the extent permitted by law, Onusuite will not be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of the service. Total liability is limited to the fees paid in the preceding 12 months.

termination.title: 11. Termination
termination.body: You may cancel at any time. Onusuite reserves the right to suspend or terminate an account for violation of these terms. After termination, your data remains accessible for 21 days in read-only mode, then archived for 90 days.

governing.title: 12. Governing Law
governing.body: These terms are governed by the law of Onusuite's country of registration. Any dispute will be submitted to the competent courts of that jurisdiction.

changes.title: 13. Changes
changes.body: Onusuite may modify these terms at any time. Changes take effect 30 days after publication. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of the changes.

contact.title: 14. Contact
contact.body: For any questions regarding these terms: contact@onusuite.com

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.body: Onusuite ("we", "our") protects the privacy of users ("you"). This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data in accordance with GDPR and applicable local regulations.

collection.title: 2. Data Collection
collection.body: We collect: name, professional email, company name, financial and accounting data entered in the platform, billing information, usage logs, and technical cookies necessary for the service to function.

use.title: 3. Use of Data
use.body: Your data is used to: provide the Onusuite service, ensure security and compliance, bill subscriptions, improve the platform, and provide technical support. We never sell your data to third parties.

sharing.title: 4. Data Sharing
sharing.body: Your data is only shared with: our hosting providers (Supabase, Cloudflare) under confidentiality agreements, tax authorities upon legal request, and your accounting firm if you explicitly authorize it.

security.title: 5. Security
security.body: All data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). Tenant isolation is enforced via PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS). Backups are automatic and encrypted. We conduct regular security audits.

retention.title: 6. Data Retention
retention.body: Your data is retained for the duration of service use. After termination: 21 days in read-only access, 90 days in encrypted archive, then permanent deletion. Billing data is retained for 10 years (legal requirement).

rights.title: 7. Your Rights
rights.body: Under GDPR, you have: right of access, rectification, erasure, portability, limitation, and objection. To exercise these rights: contact@onusuite.com

cookies.title: 8. Cookies
cookies.body: Onusuite uses only technical cookies necessary for operation (authentication session, language and currency preferences). No advertising or third-party tracking cookies are used.

children.title: 9. Children's Privacy
children.body: Onusuite is intended for professionals and businesses. The service is not accessible to persons under 18. We do not knowingly collect any data from minors.

international.title: 10. International Transfers
international.body: Your data may be processed in the European Union, the United States, or Africa. All transfers are governed by Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) compliant with GDPR.

changes.title: 11. Changes
changes.body: This policy may be modified at any time. Changes take effect 30 days after publication on this page.

contact.title: 12. Contact
contact.body: For any questions regarding privacy: contact@onusuite.com
